description: A reusable license-plated tote (ADR 0054) and its contents. Its logical location is the bin it is stowed in.

siteId.description: The site of the tote's bin. Absent until its first stow.

binId.description: The bin the tote is stowed in (its logical location). Absent until its first stow.

contents.description: One entry per stock unit in the tote, ordered by SKU then stock unit id; empty, never null.

items.description: One stock unit in a tote, in eaches.

ownerRef.description: Whose stock it is; omitted for fleet-owned stock (ADR 0045).
